title.narrative: Enhancing Digital Literacy Among Afghan Journalists

description.narrative: Introduction: In the evolving landscape of digital media, the role of journalists as gatekeepers of truth and integrity is more vital than ever, particularly in the countries like Afghanistan where access to reliable information is crucial for societal progress and stability. Recognizing the significance of equipping Afghan journalists with robust digital literacy skills, this workplan endeavors to fortify their capacity to verify information, counter misinformation, disinformation and hate speech, and uphold ethical journalism practices in the digital era. Objectives: The primary objective of this workplan is to bolster digital literacy skills among journalists in Afghanistan. This work plan seeks to enhance their ability to verify information, combat misinformation, disinformation, and hate speech, while also upholding ethical journalism standards in the digital age. The following are the main objectives of the workplan: 1. To conduct a comprehensive needs assessment survey to identify specific digital literacy gaps among Afghan journalists, thereby informing the design and implementation of tailored training programmes. 2. To develop comprehensive digital literacy training materials and resources, focusing on digital verification techniques, combating misinformation, disinformation and hate speech, and adhering to ethical standards in reporting. 3. To orchestrate dynamic and participatory digital literacy training sessions and workshops, catering to diverse learning preferences and logistical constraints, with a particular emphasis on empowering women journalists. 4. To empower Afghan journalists to apply the knowledge gained from the training sessions by producing reports and roundtables focusing on digital literacy and countering misinformation, disinformation, and hate speech. 5. To establish a vibrant and inclusive digital literacy support network for Afghan journalists, facilitating peer-to-peer learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development opportunities. 6. To conduct comprehensive follow-up assessments and evaluations to measure the impact of the digital literacy training program on Afghan journalists, informing program refinements and strategic decision-making for future cohorts. Key Activities: Assessment and Programme Design Development of Training Materials Training Sessions and Workshops Creation of Contents Evaluation Deliverables: Progress Report Final Report Conclusion: Through the implementation of this comprehensive workplan, the main aim is to empower Afghan journalists with essential digital literacy skills, knowledge, and resources to enable them to navigate the complexities of the digital age effectively, combat disinformation, uphold journalistic standards, and contribute to the production of accurate, credible, and trustworthy news content that serves the public interest and promotes independent values and principles of Afghan society.
